sermon.title: God Reveals Himself to and Corrects Unbelievers Part 2
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Daniel urged the king to break off his sins. Instead he boasted and was driven out until he learned the Most High rules. Looking up to heaven, his reason returned and he praised God, who abases the proud—a lesson in humility like Moses’.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.short_answer: Break off your sins by righteousness and mercy—it may lengthen your tranquility.
chunks.text:
Now, here’s Daniel’s advice to the king. Powerful advice. Or I got the second title. How to avoid God’s correction. See, God’s going to correct Nebuchadnezzar. That’s what the dream is saying. And Daniel tells him how to avoid God’s correction, God’s punishment. Any interested in that? How many of you want to go through God’s correction? No, you don’t want to go through it. You have to go through it if you’re wrong. And you have to go through it if you’re right. And God is dealing with what? Your whole family, a whole church, or a whole nation. Hallelujah. But you don’t want to go through that. You just want to learn by listening to the father and doing what he says.

Wouldn’t that be nice, parents, if our kids just listened to us the first time? That they didn’t have to be corrected. Hallelujah. Okay. Truth number two. What was truth number one? The Most High rules in the kingdoms of men and gives it to whomsoever he will. The heavens rule. Truth number two, repentance. Look at this. Look at this. Daniel tells the king, verse 27, “Break off your sins by righteousness, not faith, not grace, not repentance.” I mean, repentance.

And what is the American churches stressing to the American believers? Faith. No matter what you do, you believe in God, everything’s cool. Grace. You don’t have to do any works because this is a grace thing. Isn’t that what they’re pushing? And penance. The Catholic Church is good at that one. Telling their people to do some suffering thing so that they can be forgiven. Aren’t you glad Jesus suffered for us want we can just repent and go on? Absolutely. But what is being pushed on American people and they’re they’re accepting it? Faith, grace, and penance. But Daniel says, “Uh-uh. Uh-uh. Break off your sins by doing right.” How do I deal with sin?

By stop doing the sin. I repent. I admit I’m wrong and I turn from that sin. I may fall a few times and go back to it, but I’m on the road to what? Leaving that sin behind me. Powerful. And Daniel had this before the new covenant even came along. And everything in the new covenant, folks, is found in the old covenant. It’s just the new covenant is the fulfillment, the reality of it all. Hallelujah. And break off your iniquities, your injustices. And justice is treating people unfairly, unrightly. See? So the king was doing some unjustice, wasn’t he?

But I wouldn’t want an audible voice from heaven when it’s going to talk like this. I’ll just take the Bible. It’s sufficient. Amen. Oh king, I can’t even do it justice. You’ll dwell with the beast of the field. They’ll make you to eat grass as oxen. And seven times shall pass over you, oh king, until you know, here’s truth number one, that three times he’s repeated it.

The most high rules in the kingdoms of men and gives it to whomsoever he will. How many of you got that truth now? Yes. All right. Three times. We ought to get it. The same hour that the voice came, the same hour was the thing fulfilled. Nebuchadnezzar was driven from men. Who drove him? Watchers Watchers. And the holy ones. He ate grass ex as auction the same hour. This is not a gradual thing. I mean, he went one minute honoring himself and he’s down there eating grass just like that. How many you know that’s humbling? You got a crown on you and robes and all of a sudden, man, you go from bragging about yourself to eating grass and you’re dealing with somebody you can’t deal with.

scriptures.text_nkjv: The king spoke, saying, “Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for a royal dwelling by my mighty power and for the honor of my majesty?” While the word was still in the king’s mouth, a voice fell from heaven: “King Nebuchadnezzar, to you it is spoken: the kingdom has departed from you! And they shall drive you from men, and your dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field. They shall make you eat grass like oxen; and seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever He chooses.”

chunks.short_answer: He lifted his eyes to heaven—all inhabitants are reputed as nothing; God does as He wills.
chunks.text:
He’s out there during this time and then something moved him to look up to the heavens. Okay. Immediately his understanding returned to him. So who took his understanding? The watchers and the holy ones took his understanding. You don’t want to mess with these guys. Okay. Number two, when his understanding returned and he looked toward the heavens, I blessed. I spoke good of God. I praised. I bragged about God and I honored the most high God who lives forever. Now that’s Revelation again. He got Revelation that God is an eternal being and he praised him.

You know how many Christians will not praise and bless God because they didn’t grow up that way? Whatever excuse. And yet this king learned to what? Bless God. Speak good of God. Praise him. Brag about God. The Bible says in Psalms, “Let the high praises of God be in thy mouth. Sing praises to God. Sing praises. Sing praises with. Understanding. Sing praises.” Psalm says. And what separates the Christians from all religions in the world is our way we pray and the way we worship. See, we lift our hands. We bow down to no symbol. We sing blessed assurance Jesus is mine.

Yeah. See, we sing joyful songs, heartbreaking songs, love songs to Jesus. Number three, more Revelation. Whose dominion is everlasting. His rulership is everlasting. And his kingdom, the area he rules over, is from generation to generation. It didn’t just start in the New Testament early church. See, his kingdom was there from the beginning. Can I hear an amen? Back in the old days, the church mainly said the sooncoming king. And then one day, the Holy Ghost revealed, “He ain’t the soon cominging king. He’s king now, and he’s king when he comes.”. And it made all the difference in our approach. Hallelujah.

All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing. You know, you think you might be something, you know, because you’re a good warrior or you’re an administrator or whatever. And God, when it’s measured up to God, you’re nothing. You ain’t nothing. And you ain’t got nothing without him giving it to you. Hallelujah. So get off your pride. He does according to his will in the army of heaven. Is there an army in heaven? Yeah. And among the inhabitants of the earth, is he involved in the affairs of men? Yes. These people that say God is not involved in affairs of men are totally biblically wrong. He is. And none can stop his hand or say unto him, “What are you doing?

What are you doing this for? What are you bringing the Jews into captivity?” Man, that’s not You’re supposed to be a loving God. What? You’re getting these guys castrated and they’re dying from famine and sicknesses and diseases. What kind of God is that? None can what? Stop his hand or say, “What are you doing?” You can’t put a guilt trip on God. He knows what he’s doing, folks. He knows who he is. Are you there? Hallelujah. At the same time, see, when he praised God, when he blessed God, when he looked to the heavens, when his understanding returned to him, when he was revealed who God was, at that same time, my reason returned to me.

My ability to think like a king, my reason, my wisdom, my ability to think and come to a logical conclusion returned to me. Now, his understanding had returned before, but now his reasoning. And how many of you know we need an ability in our mind that connect with our spiritual mind to know how to resolve a conflict, a problem and come up with the right answer. Yes. Amen. Just knowing about the Bible doesn’t help. Reasoning, being able to use the Bible in its time and in its place is what makes the difference. And that was returned to him. See, a lot of Christians have knowledge of the Bible, but they have no reasoning. They can’t reason the Bible with you. They come up with the craziest things I ever heard in my life.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And at the end of the time I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted my eyes to heaven, and my understanding returned to me; and I blessed the Most High and praised and honored Him who lives forever: For His dominion is an everlasting dominion, And His kingdom is from generation to generation. All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; He does according to His will in the army of heaven And among the inhabitants of the earth. No one can restrain His hand Or say to Him, “What have You done?”

chunks.short_answer: God is truth, Satan the liar; those who walk in pride He can abase—Moses’ humility took no credit.
chunks.text:
I was one of them back there when I was a young Christian. But reading the Bible every year and studying it really changed me in about a year and a half. It just revolutionized my life and my reasoning returned for the honor of my kingdom. And my honor and the brightness returned unto me. My counselors and lords sought unto me. Now, I mean, you know, counselors and lords aren’t going to go out to some guy eating grass. Something wrong here. But because of the watchers and the holy ones, they didn’t dare do anything to this king. Isn’t that something? Ever what this time period was, they didn’t do anything. But now that he’s back to normal, here they come. Cuz see, they didn’t have any answers.
